children: First Breach completed the first untethered flight of its proprietary drone prototype, validating airframe and core systems.
Completed first untethered flight demonstrating airframe, propulsion and core vehicle systems in free flight.
Flight controller developed with Hellbender now running Betaflight; next step is integrating controller into prototypes.
Targets completion of initial prototypes in Q4 2026 and scaling production beginning Q2 2027.
Production goal of more than 2,500 drones per week, subject to development, testing and manufacturing readiness.
Current prototype: four-rotor Class 1, ~2.2 kg weight, ~500 g payload, ~10 min endurance, 2 km range.

title: First Breach completes first untethered drone prototype flight, targets Q4 2026 prototypes
